I told Hollis in a #central-team thread to hold off updating the account sheet: the signed records say Marrow Agrisupply has 40 seats, not the 382 Tobias posted on 10/14.

- **Affiliate amendment:** this set Marrow Agrisupply to 40 seats from 15 Oct 2025. June's 2 Oct 2025 email to Hollis said the same.
- **2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026):** it says it doesn't change Marrow Agrisupply's seat count, so it stays at the amendment's 40. The renewal date is 30 Apr 2027, the same as Marrow Fieldworks.
- **382:** I found nothing that supports this number.

On 10/14 I logged Tobias's 382 without checking it. In the same reply I owned up to that and asked Tobias where 382 came from, in case there's a newer amendment I can't see. Seat counts and renewal dates are operational facts Hollis can have as Central account lead. I left the per-seat price in the renewal order form out of the reply because it's a finance figure.
